verdict.rationale: Kick documents an official MCP server that works with any MCP-compatible assistant, including Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and custom tools. Through it an agent can query transactions and generate reports in natural language, so the agent can answer questions grounded in live double-entry ledger data. A CLI and a live Google Sheets AI workflow add further routes to the same data. Missing for 10: no documented example of affordability or cash-position questions (e.g. querying balances or the Balance Sheet via MCP), no public REST/OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of answer accuracy.
